results.rationale: Consistency: white backdrop and green/red product scheme remain, but tray position/geometry and many can labels and pull tabs change visibly. Instruction: the separate right can is removed from its old position and stands on the cans in the left tray, satisfying the requested relocation. Quality: repeated malformed label lettering and distorted pull tabs are distracting despite the coherent overall product arrangement.

Consistency: jacket colors, backdrop and zipper design persist, but the sleeve pose and orange stripe layout change beyond a viewpoint transformation. Instruction: the jacket rotates toward a frontal oblique view and still exposes its full torso; it does not show the overhead shoulder-and-neck projection in the reference. Quality: a coherent jacket rendering with natural folds, smooth shading and no obvious structural artifacts.
